narrative.overview: A dark, evidence-led portfolio for scanning active product experiments and systems research. The visual system stays futuristic but restrained so project proof, Agent mechanisms and product judgment remain primary.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Signal Cyan is reserved for clickable, current or important elements.

rules.name: The Evidence First Rule
rules.body: Every judgment must be followed by a mechanism, boundary or artifact.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Strong shadows and glow only appear as state feedback.

dos: Do use project screenshots and primary sources as evidence.
Do explain Agent mechanisms and product impact.
Do provide real anchors and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't ship generic AI SaaS landing-page clichés.
Don't stack technical terms without mechanisms and boundaries.
Don't use decorative neon, default glassmorphism or complex motion performance.
